[slide 2]
HOHUNET概览
Overview of HOHUNET
2015年注册成立  总部位于深圳，并在成都设立了分公司。 公司的 2/3为研发技术人员，且多为资深技术研发人员，主要技术人员来自于 HUAWEI/ LENOVO/ ADVA
Registered in 2015, the company is headquartered in Shenzhen and has set up a branch in Chengdu. Two-thirds of our staff are R&D technicians, and most of them are senior R&D personnel, and the main technical personnel are from HUAWEI, LENOVO, ADVA.
专注于基于国产芯片的以太网交换机研发与销售，为客户提供从单端口1G到800G速率以太网交换机
Focusing on the development and sales of Ethernet switches based on domestic chips, the company provides customers with Ethernet switches ranging from 1G to 800G.
自研三层网络操作系统HOS  应用于AI智算/数据中心/运营商/企业/园区/SMB网络/电竞网络
Our Self-developed Layer3 network operating system HOS is applied to AI computing, data center, the operator’s network, the enterprise’s network, the Campus’s  network, the SMB network and the E-sports network.
产品用户分部在全球   海外业务营收占比超50%   业务模式灵活多样 OEM/ODM/SKD/CKD
Our Products users are all over the world. Overseas business revenue accounts for more than 50%, and our flexible business model includes OEM, ODM, SKD, and CKD.
在中国.东莞/海宁，菲律宾.拉古那 有先进制造伙伴  与业内头部厂商使用相同生产线（HUAWEI/HPE/H3C)    相同的生产工艺相同的质量管控相同的物料体系
We have established partnerships with advanced manufacturing entities in Dongguan and Haining, China, as well as in Laguna, Philippines.  In production, we adopt the same production lines,  production process, quality control systems and material systems as those of renowned industry leaders such as HUAWEI, HPE and H3C.

[slide 3]
注册成立，并基于国产芯片研发与销售电子竞技网络通信设备

2015

数据中心TOR产品被欧洲/美国客户广泛使用
The data center TOR products have been widely used by customers in Europe and the United States.
完成主要元器件的国产化替代
Completed the localized replacement of major components.
多速率及POE++产品系列批量出货，形成独特的竞争优势
The multi-gigabit and POE++ products have been shipped in batches.A unique competitive edge has been formed.
2019
100G/25G产品批量上市销售
The 100G/25G products have launched.
推出苹果IOS设备有限接入与充电设备（全球首创）
Had launched the world's first limited-access and charging device for Apple iOS devices.
聚焦数据中心 25G/100G产品研发
Have focued on the research and development of 25G/100G products for data centers.
200G/400G/800G产品研发
Has invested in the research and development of 200G/400G/800G products

HOHUNET 11年沿革
HOHUNET 11 Years of History
2026
新1G接入产品上市，补齐低端产品线，实现1G到800G统一软件平台全覆盖。
New 1G access product will be launched to fill the low-end gap,  The unified HOS software platform will cover the range of 1G-800G.

团队成员平均拥10年以上的交换机产品工作经验

对网络协议栈深度理解

前瞻性的技术输出
The team members have an average of over 10 years of working experience in switch products.
Covering modules such as kernel, BSP (Board Support Package), driver, MAC chip driver, and business protocols.
They have a deep understanding of the network protocol stack, possess the ability to design distributed systems (stacking, SDN).
Provide forward-looking technical outputs.
测试及技术支持团队
Verification and Technical Support
十余年测试用例积累，全协议栈测试覆盖良好。
资深测试工程师组建专业团队，可构建复杂组网测试，保障测试深度。
自研自动化测试平台，测试高效。
配备专业测试仪器设备，极限性能测试结论可靠。
完善的缺陷跟踪管理系统。
Decades of test script accumulation ensures full protocol stack coverage.
Senior engineers form a professional team for complex network tests, ensuring depth.
Our self-developed auto-test platform enables high-efficiency.
Professional equipment guarantees reliable extreme-performance test results.
A perfect defect-tracking system is in place.

HOHUNET 的软件平台架构概览
HOHUNET Operate System overview
HOS 经历了10年以上持续的升级迭代。
10+ years of development  and continuous iteration  and upgrade.
HOS在广泛的商业，政府和运营商网络中得到验证。
Verifying within a wide-ranging, live commercial, Government or ISP networks.
功能模块化，可移植性，可裁剪性强
The functions are modularized, and it has strong portability and high tailor ability.
HOS 采用归一化的软件平台，各型号交换机沿用同一套软件，统一管理风格。
HOS is a Unified Operate System. Each switches use the one set of software,
ensuring a unified management style.

[slide 8]
HOHUNET 的云管理平台
HOHUNET Cloud Center
自主开发的云平台管理系统，帮助客户简化设备管理，比如：自动生成拓扑功能。
The self-developed cloud platform management system helps customers simplify device management. For example, automatically generates topologies.
通过加密隧道进行设备配置，安全又高效
Device configuration is carried out through an encrypted tunnel, which is both secure and efficient.
可授权技术人员进行远程接入，提高技术支持的效率。技术支持完毕后关闭授权，保证安全性。
Technicians can be authorized for remote access to improve the efficiency of technical support. After the technical support is completed, the authorization will be closed to ensure security.

2015年注册成立  总部位于深圳，并在成都设立了分公司。 公司的 2/3为研发技术人员，且多为资深技术研发人员，主要技术人员来自于 HUAWEI/ LENOVO/ ADVA
Registered in 2015, the company is headquartered in Shenzhen and has set up a branch in Chengdu. Two-thirds of our staff are R&D technicians, and most of them are senior R&D personnel, and the main technical personnel are from HUAWEI, LENOVO, ADVA.

专注于基于国产芯片的以太网交换机研发与销售，为客户提供从单端口1G到800G速率以太网交换机
Focusing on the development and sales of Ethernet switches based on domestic chips, the company provides customers with Ethernet switches ranging from 1G to 800G.

自研三层网络操作系统HOS  应用于AI智算/数据中心/运营商/企业/园区/SMB网络/电竞网络
Our Self-developed Layer3 network operating system HOS is applied to AI computing, data center, the operator’s network, the enterprise’s network, the Campus’s  network, the SMB network and the E-sports network.

产品用户分部在全球   海外业务营收占比超50%   业务模式灵活多样 OEM/ODM/SKD/CKD
Our Products users are all over the world. Overseas business revenue accounts for more than 50%, and our flexible business model includes OEM, ODM, SKD, and CKD.

在中国.东莞/海宁，菲律宾.拉古那 有先进制造伙伴  与业内头部厂商使用相同生产线（HUAWEI/HPE/H3C)    相同的生产工艺相同的质量管控相同的物料体系
We have established partnerships with advanced manufacturing entities in Dongguan and Haining, China, as well as in Laguna, Philippines.  In production, we adopt the same production lines,  production process, quality control systems and material systems as those of renowned industry leaders such as HUAWEI, HPE and H3C.

注册成立，并基于国产芯片研发与销售电子竞技网络通信设备
It has been registered, and has engaged in the research, development equipments based on domestic chips.

成为中国电子竞技网络行业出货量第一的团队
Has become the team with the highest shipment volume in Chinese E-sports network  industry.

推出第一款数据中心TOR交换产品
Launched the first data center TOR switching product.

数据中心TOR产品被欧洲/美国客户广泛使用
The data center TOR products have been widely used by customers in Europe and the United States.

完成主要元器件的国产化替代
Completed the localized replacement of major components.

多速率及POE++产品系列批量出货，形成独特的竞争优势
The multi-gigabit and POE++ products have been shipped in batches.A unique competitive edge has been formed.

100G/25G产品批量上市销售
The 100G/25G products have launched.

推出苹果IOS设备有限接入与充电设备（全球首创）
Had launched the world's first limited-access and charging device for Apple iOS devices.

聚焦数据中心 25G/100G产品研发
Have focued on the research and development of 25G/100G products for data centers.
